short_description:
Where to start hunting in GTA 6: Bret texts Jason in Chapter 2 and the first hunt, Veteran Hunted, starts in the far north of Lummox County by Mount Kalaga. Go as Jason, alone. The first job pays $500, and Bret has more hunting jobs after it. Unlike fishing (catch and release, no cash), hunting pays. A clean shot keeps the animal's quality up. Details come from fan guides (GTABase, PowerPyx, eGamers): check your map. No story spoilers.

📍 Map Spot #31 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Sources: GTABase, PowerPyx, eGamers, AllThings.How.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).
